$comment: Vehicle motion and size for every region and operator (packages/transit-core/src/config.ts → resolveKinematics). An operator (config/operators/<id>/operator.json → kinematics.modes) overrides a mode's settings, a route (its feed's routes.json → kinematics) any of them. Sources: 'guess' unless noted; see config/regions/metro-vancouver/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #9, #12, #13. accel/decel in m/s², speeds in km/h, lengths/widths in metres. 'minCruiseFraction': when the schedule allows more time than needed, run no slower than this fraction of maxSpeed and hold the remainder as extra dwell at the origin (packages/transit-core/DESIGN.md#movements-and-playback). 'dwell' is used when GTFS arrival == departure (true for all SkyTrain stops). Buses move along their profile ('linear'), so their speed settings aren't used.

sizing.$comment: Vehicles are drawn to true scale when zoomed in, but never smaller than this many pixels long, so they stay visible at city zoom.
